# Monster and Ritual Names

Point at another monster or ritual by its name, so your Wolf grows into the monster you meant, whatever mods a player adds or removes.

The game alone can't read the name: put these lines in the .c5se or on `#!@` lines.

!!! info "More in the game's manual"
    These commands are in Illwinter's official modding manual. The monster ones are under ["Monster Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=14), and `gainrit` under ["Ritual Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=33).

### spawnoffs "&lt;monster&gt;" { #spawnoffs data-toc-label="spawnoffs and the rest" }

Points the command at the first monster with that name, capitals ignored. The same works in `growoffs`, `lookslike`, `landshape`, `watershape`, `elysiumshape`, `celestialshape`, `skyshape`, `agarthashape`, `infernoshape`, `hadesshape`, `aztlanshape`, `primalshape`, `elementalshape` and `voidshape`.

- **monster:** The monster's name. It must exist before the line: the game's, this mod's, or an earlier mod's. `1:"<monster>"` is the second monster with that name, up to `99:`.

=== ".c5se"

    The first monster with the name:

    ```c5se
    spawnoffs "Giant Spider"
    ```

    Or the second:

    ```c5se
    growoffs 1:"Longdead"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    The first monster with the name:

    ```c5m
    #!@spawnoffs "Giant Spider"
    ```

    Or the second:

    ```c5m
    #!@growoffs 1:"Longdead"
    ```

### gainrit "&lt;ritual&gt;" [n] { #gainrit data-toc-label="gainrit" }

Teaches the ritual with that name, capitals ignored. Goes after `newritual` or `selectritual`.

- **ritual:** The ritual's name. It must exist before the line.
- **n:** 0 for the first ritual with that name, 1 for the second. Without it, the first.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    gainrit "Ritual of Mastery"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@gainrit "Ritual of Mastery"
    ```

### Example names { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newmonster "Mirkwood Spider"
    copystats "Giant Spider"
    copyspr "Giant Spider"
    lookslike "Giant Spider"

    selectritual "Lesser Ritual of Mastery"
    gainrit "Ritual of Mastery"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newmonster "Mirkwood Spider"
    copystats "Giant Spider"
    copyspr "Giant Spider"
    #!@lookslike "Giant Spider"

    selectritual "Lesser Ritual of Mastery"
    #!@gainrit "Ritual of Mastery"
    ```
